skills_in_order: Spreadsheet fundamentals | Descriptive statistics | Probability basics | SQL basics | Spreadsheet analysis
phase_objective_derived: Build quantitative and technical data foundations across spreadsheets, descriptive statistics, probability rules, and basic SQL retrieval. Learn to organize tabular data, compute statistical distributions, summarize datasets with formulas and pivot tables, and query relational databases.
learner_outcome_derived: The learner can manipulate and summarize spreadsheet datasets with advanced lookups, compute descriptive statistics and probability distributions, and execute baseline SQL queries to extract and filter records.

skills_in_order: SQL joins and aggregation | Python basics | pandas data wrangling | Git and version control
phase_objective_derived: Master intermediate SQL querying techniques including multi-table joins and aggregation alongside foundational Python programming and pandas DataFrame wrangling. Establish disciplined version control workflows using Git and GitHub for project tracking and portfolio publishing.
learner_outcome_derived: The learner can combine and aggregate multi-table SQL databases, write modular Python scripts to clean and reshape tabular data in pandas, and version-control analytics projects on GitHub.

skills_in_order: Data cleaning and quality | Exploratory data analysis | Data visualisation principles | Python visualisation
phase_objective_derived: Develop end-to-end data auditing, cleaning, and exploratory data analysis capabilities using Python. Learn to diagnose data quality anomalies, conduct systematic univariate and bivariate analyses, and build communicative charts using matplotlib, seaborn, and clear visual design principles.
learner_outcome_derived: The learner can identify and remediate data quality defects, conduct comprehensive exploratory data analyses on raw datasets, and produce publication-ready statistical visualizations.

skills_in_order: Advanced SQL | BI dashboards | Inferential statistics and A/B testing | Business metrics and KPIs
phase_objective_derived: Advance into complex data analysis by constructing analytical SQL subqueries, CTEs, and window functions alongside dimensional BI data modeling in Power BI or Looker Studio. Master inferential statistical hypothesis testing, A/B experiment evaluation, and core commercial business KPIs.
learner_outcome_derived: The learner can write complex analytical SQL with window functions, build interactive dimensional BI dashboards with calculated measures, design and evaluate A/B experiments, and compute business funnel metrics.

skills_in_order: Regression basics | Data storytelling | Analytics case interviews
phase_objective_derived: Synthesize analytical competencies into predictive modeling intuition, executive data storytelling, and timed technical interview performance. Learn to fit and interpret regression models, translate quantitative findings into strategic business recommendations, and solve analytics case studies under time pressure.
learner_outcome_derived: The learner can interpret regression relationships, deliver compelling data presentations to stakeholders, and successfully solve product analytics cases and timed SQL technical interviews.
